before: insertHyperlink took no tooltip, a first link in a document without a Hyperlink style got no character style, and in suggesting mode a new link target changed the link in place and removing a link unwrapped it, both with no revision.
after: insertHyperlink writes a tooltip, a first link adds Word's Hyperlink character style in the same transaction, and in suggesting mode a new target, a new link over existing words, or a link removal strikes plain one-format text and inserts a tracked copy with its format, in a link unless the link is removed; other text refuses the change.
reason: Every write uses operations and package edits that released replicas already apply: insertText, deleteText, setRunProperties, insertHyperlink with a styleId and tooltip, removeHyperlink with a range, and a styles part edit replicated as canonical primitives, as the List Paragraph style already is. A removeHyperlink range may now cover tracked text in the link; only the writing replica validates the operation, and peers replay its canonical primitives. Shared nodes, text offsets, and the operation vocabulary are unchanged.
